threatModelDelta: Server creates and persists one bounded PNG plus validated appearance; client supplies only catalog IDs. Portrait copies cross identity, training snapshots and answer replay storage.

checks.clientPngOrRemoteUrl: Ignored by avatar route; validateAvatar copies exactly 11 allowlisted fields; server composes from its configured local accepted atlas.
checks.authorization: Session required before save and rechecked inside identity write queue; activity starts use authenticated user snapshot.
checks.pngResourceBounds: Stored PNG <=128 KiB, exactly160x160 RGBA8 with binary alpha; atlas <=4 MiB/1024 per dimension; inflate output bounded to exact scanlines; chunk CRC/order/end verified; APNG and foreign critical chunks rejected.
checks.urlAndMetadataBoundary: Only canonical data:image/png;base64 accepted; encoder emits IHDR/IDAT/IEND without URLs or metadata; source uses local file reads and cannot follow manifest atlas URLs.
checks.identityAtomicity: Avatar+PNG written together to 0600 temporary file, file sync then rename, in-memory pair published after success; queue remains usable after write failure.
checks.activityAtomicity: Async draft transactions awaited before serialization/commit; returned values cloned; existing session portraits retained across wardrobe edits and restart.
checks.migration: Missing identity PNG generated once from stored profile; valid existing PNG needs no atlas; damaged existing PNG fails closed; legacy blitz uses historical full snapshot; old ordinary shift without full profile remains without invented PNG.
checks.cachedAnswerPortraits: Every present cached profile/PNG now validated against historical canonical pair; missing legacy copies filled from that pair; corruption never silently replaced.
checks.publicRosterPrivacy: Public roster remains id/displayName/groupId/hasCode only; no avatar, PNG, credentials, hashes, roles or login history added.

resolvedFindings.finding: TrainingStore validated canonical shift PNG but did not validate cached response.equipment.avatarPortrait. A corrupted persisted cached URL survived restart and was returned on ordinary answer replay.
resolvedFindings.fix: Validate cached profile and PNG, enforce equality with the historical canonical pair, migrate only missing legacy copies.
resolvedFindings.regressionTest: restart rejects a corrupted or substituted cached answer portrait; absent legacy copies reuse the historical PNG

independentValidation.additionalProbe: Real temporary training store, corrupted cached PNG only, restart now rejects and leaves bytes unchanged.

boundaries: Review covers this portrait persistence/rendering delta, not a new global security certification of the application.
Real HTTP integration is performed separately by orchestrator; this reviewer ran service-level tests and temporary-file reproduction.
Browser rendering, physical GPU, packaged Linux deployment and power-loss durability were not exercised by this review.
Existing roster disclosure and login policies are unchanged; no public registration or third-party asset request introduced.
